title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – A Closer look at the Free “Internal Administrator” and “Dynamics 365 Administrator” Licences
summary: Business Central offers free administrative licenses to Microsoft 365 tenant administrators who perform setup and security tasks. The Internal Administrator and Dynamics 365 Administrator licenses are automatically assigned to Global Administrators and Dynamics 365 Administrators respectively, giving them limited administrative capabilities without purchasing paid licenses.
key_points: The Internal Administrator licence is given automatically to Microsoft 365 Global Administrators the first time they open Business Central
The Dynamics 365 Administrator licence is given automatically to holders of that Microsoft tenant role when they open Business Central
Both free licences allow limited admin work such as managing users, assigning permissions and creating permission sets; Internal Administrator also has read-only access everywhere
Running Update users from Microsoft 365 does not create these users; they must sign in via the Business Central URL
Using these licences avoids paying for IT admin seats and improves segregation of duties
